description: One Brand Upgrade: soundcore is now Anker soundcore. We've always been part of Anker — now our name says it. Same products, same quality, same team. Your app, your account, and your warranty work exactly as before. Only the name has changed. Crystal-Clear Calls: Powered by the ANKER Thus AI chip, 4 mics and 2 VPUs isolate your voice instead of filtering noises, so you can speak naturally in 80+ db noisy environments or whisper in quiet rooms, and still be heard clearly. Certified by Guinness World Records. GoldenFit Design For Secure Comfort: Built on 2,000+ ear scans, the GoldenFit C-bridge keeps a secure, comfortable hold, while the contoured acoustic and battery chambers follow your ear's curve. At just 6.2 g per earbud, it feels barely there, even all day long. Deep Bass, Brilliant Highs: Enjoy Hi-Res Audio with LDAC and a 12 mm dual-magnet driver featuring an aerospace-grade metal and advanced polymer diaphragm. Hear punchy lows and detailed highs for an immersive listening experience. AI Translation in 100+ Languages: Break language barriers with real-time, two-way translation through the soundcore app. Communicate effortlessly at work or while traveling. From Anker, Trusted by 80 Million+ Users Worldwide: AeroClip 2 brings together crystal-clear calls, Hi-Res Audio, GoldenFit comfort, and AI translation in one premium open-ear design, giving you a clearer, more confident experience at work and in everyday life. Tips: If you pay via Tryon, you will not be eligible for the free gift.
